legend.0: The writing lacks coherence; organization seems haphazard and disjointed. Even after rereading, the reader remains confused.

legend.5: The organization enhances the central idea(s) and its development. The order and structure are compelling and move the reader through the text easily.

legend.0: The writing lacks coherence; organization seems haphazard and disjointed. Even after rereading, the reader remains confused.

legend.5: The organization enhances the central idea(s) and its development. The order and structure are compelling and move the reader through the text easily.
